scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @starcorsair/server && npm run build -w @starcorsair/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @starcorsair/shared && npm run typecheck -w @starcorsair/server && npm run typecheck -w @starcorsair/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @starcorsair/shared && npm run test -w @starcorsair/server
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @starcorsair/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @starcorsair/client
